description.en: Native desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness, with a selectable and customisable synthesised chime.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 原生桌面通知，自带可选择、可自定义的合成提示音。

description.en: Native desktop notifications from DeepSeek Harness itself: approval requests, questions, finished tasks, errors and sign-in prompts. Banners are attributed to the DSH app, a click focuses DSH and opens the conversation, and the chime can be chosen from presets or authored as a note sequence.
description.zh: 由 DSH 自己弹出的原生桌面通知：需要确认权限、等待作答、任务完成、执行出错、需要登录时提醒你。通知归属于 DeepSeek Harness 应用，点击回到 DSH 并打开对应会话；提示音可选预设或自定义音高序列。
